tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground behind everything. The Studio never sits on white.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles, inputs' surroundings, dialogs: anything that is an object on the page.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Board columns, progress tracks, wells, skeleton base.

tokens.name: paper-tint
tokens.usage: Hover on rows and tiles; empty translation cells; dashed drop zones.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Inside text inputs and editors only, so typing surfaces read as paper you write on.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the 2px outline of every object (cards, dialogs, tables, buttons). 12:1 on paper.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, labels. ≥6:1 on paper and paper-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders, drag grips, disabled text. Still ≥5:1; never for the only copy of an instruction.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Dotted dividers between rows and fields (2px dotted). Decorative only.

tokens.name: ink-line
tokens.usage: The 1.5px edge of text inputs, search boxes and editors; ink on hover and focus. Objects keep ink. ≥3:1 on field, paper and paper-sunk in both themes.

tokens.name: chocolate
tokens.usage: Top bar, command palette shadow, toasts, the offline banner. Code wells have --code.

tokens.name: chocolate-soft
tokens.usage: Sidebar ground; inputs inside the top bar.

tokens.name: on-chocolate
tokens.usage: Text on chocolate and chocolate-soft (12:1).

tokens.name: on-chocolate-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text in the top bar and sidebar.

tokens.name: code
tokens.usage: Code wells: blocks of code, terminals, requests and answers. Dark in both themes, so code reads the same everywhere.

tokens.name: on-code
tokens.usage: Code and plain text in a code well.

tokens.name: on-code-muted
tokens.usage: Comments, punctuation, line numbers and labels in a code well.

tokens.name: code-rule
tokens.usage: Lines between rows and panes inside a code well. Decorative only.

tokens.name: code-keyword
tokens.usage: Keywords, keys and the line being pointed at in a code well.

tokens.name: code-string
tokens.usage: Strings and values in a code well.

tokens.name: code-function
tokens.usage: Function names, numbers and constants in a code well.

tokens.name: code-focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring on controls inside a code well (draw it without --focus-edge there).

tokens.name: mustard
tokens.usage: The signature fill, for small things: the selected item, counts, review state, highlights. Always with ink text (6.7:1). A big 'needs you' panel takes panel-highlight.

tokens.name: on-mustard
tokens.usage: Text on mustard in both themes (6.7:1).

tokens.name: mustard-soft
tokens.usage: Inserted text in diffs, freshly added rows, warning suggestions.

tokens.name: panel-highlight
tokens.usage: A big panel that calls for you ('needs you', getting started): mustard in Lights on, mustard-soft in Lights off, where a wall of mustard glares. Pair with on-panel-highlight and shadow-panel-highlight. Selections, counts and small highlights stay mustard.

tokens.name: on-panel-highlight
tokens.usage: Text on panel-highlight: on-mustard in Lights on (6.7:1), ink in Lights off.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Decorative fills and display italics ≥28px, stripes, cursors. NOT for small text or white-on-orange buttons (3.7:1).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary buttons (Publish, Save, New). Pair with on-action.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text on action: 5.2:1 light, 6.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: rust
tokens.usage: Danger and errors: text on paper (5.2:1), deletions in diffs, stamps, links.

tokens.name: rust-soft
tokens.usage: Background of blocking problems and deleted text.

tokens.name: avocado
tokens.usage: Large fills for 'live' and success areas (tiles, stubs). Text on it: on-avocado, and only large (18.5px bold or 24px).

tokens.name: on-avocado
tokens.usage: Large text on avocado: ink in Lights on (3.8:1), Lights-off paper in Lights off (7.7:1), where cream ink would be 2.0:1.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Live status pill and success buttons. White text on it in light (6.4:1), paper text in dark.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of live pills and 'all caught up' notices.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Warning text on paper (5.2:1): suggestions, counters near their limit.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Scheduled and informational: 'goes out Nov 13', scheduled pills, info notes.

tokens.name: teal-soft
tokens.usage: Background of scheduled pills.

tokens.name: plum
tokens.usage: Sixth presence colour; never a status.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 3px focus ring offset 2px, on every interactive element, with --focus-edge filling the gap inside it: mustard alone is 1.8:1 on Lights-on paper.

tokens.name: on-plum
tokens.usage: Text on plum and teal fills (presence tabs, type squares).

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono Variable", "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Overview greetings and poster numbers. One per screen.

styles.name: item
styles.usage: Entry names on cards, agenda rows, locale column heads.

styles.name: voice
styles.usage: The Studio speaking: empty translations, gentle notes, secondary titles.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Le 14 mars 1976, à 4 h 12, le HORIZON-E a quitté la surface.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Names, button labels, emphasis in rows.

styles.name: kbd
styles.usage: Keyboard hints, inside a 2px ink box.

styles.name: celebrate
styles.usage: Celebrations only: an issue published, a first entry. At most once per session.

styles.name: empty
styles.usage: Empty states. One line, then a plain sentence and one action.

styles.name: memo
styles.usage: Recipe cards and the settings memo outtakes; optional per project.

shadow.note: Discothèque has no soft shadows. Objects that lift get a hard offset in ink, like a sheet of card stock on a desk.

tokens.name: shadow-press
tokens.usage: Primary buttons at rest; collapses to 0 on press.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Hovered cards, selected nav item.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Command palette, popovers, side panels.

tokens.name: shadow-drag
tokens.usage: Anything being dragged.

tokens.name: shadow-highlight
tokens.usage: A preview or field that just changed (new structure preview, toast).

tokens.name: shadow-panel-highlight
tokens.usage: The shadow of a panel-highlight panel: none in Lights on, where the panel is mustard already; a mustard offset in Lights off, so the soft panel still reads as the one that calls for you.
